style: Vibrant pixel art. Deep navy and azure palette with bright orange fire and metallic silver highlights.
notes: Rewrite (2026-10). All five images are kept from the 2025 page; their prompts are the originals, trimmed, kept as a record and not meant to be regenerated. The preset is the closest match to how they look, not the one they were made with.

images.prompt: Low-angle wide shot of a massive azure armored helicopter emerging from a swirling blue vortex above a burning city at night, meteorites streaking down trailing fire and smoke.
Close view of blocky water droplets splashing onto burning wooden beams between grey stone blocks, the fire hissing out where the water lands.

Cockpit view of two weapons aimed through the canopy at a falling meteorite cluster: on the left a water cannon with a transparent blue tank and pressure gauges, on the right an autocannon with an ammunition feed.

Portrait action shot of the azure armored helicopter bursting through a cracked dimensional portal, a pilot at the controls, burning scenes from different eras behind it: a library, a modern city under meteorites, old stone buildings.

Isometric map of a fractured landscape of floating islands from different eras, castles, villages and a modern city, joined by glowing rift paths, the azure helicopter flying between them as meteorites fall.
